adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, the mutation awaits `eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees(evt, booking);` and then awaits `sendAddGuestsEmails(evt, guests);` (which builds a `Promise.all` over organizer + each team member + each attendee). Because both are executed inline on the request path, total mutation latency will scale with attendee/team size and external calendar/email provider latency. This is a performance/architecture concern introduced by this change, not a functional defect per se.
